name: atlas-obsidian
description: One Obsidian vault holds the wiki, the threads, the sessions, and the changes of your work. Agents start in the vault, find the repository through the context graph, and leave a document for every step. Eighteen skills on four nouns (atlas, repo, wiki, thread), four read-only agents, and hooks that keep the rules and a document for every session. Pairs with the atlas binary, which serves the eight tools.
